decision_rule: This stage makes no inferential decision and cannot: it is blind to which context is which and the endpoint rules live in DESIGN_SUFFIX.md (as amended 2026-08-15), evaluated by analyze_suffix.py. COMPLETE only if there is exactly one row per (blind context, suffix, item, family, decode, sample index), every row carries its full prompt and its verbatim generation, all three context labels are present, and no row carries a true context name; otherwise INCOMPLETE and nothing downstream may be read.
notes: Context labels are a fresh os.urandom permutation onto A/B/E, stored ONLY in suffix_blind_key.json. Suffix names are deliberately unblinded: they are the text under study and are visible in every saved prompt. Seeding unit is the generate() call: seed_mode=cell-batched, and every row carries both its own table seed and the seed actually applied. R1 (first-token) fields come from one forward pass per prompt through run_sitref's readout code, so the digit token set matches the stage-17 anchor exactly. Full generations are saved per row (R3) because stage 13 was caught by reading transcripts, not summaries. The greedy anchors are decoded in batches with left padding, so batch composition can perturb them at the numerical margin; they are an anchor, no endpoint reads them, and every endpoint is bound to the sampled rows.
